verifyNote: Prices from the PHB equipment tables, from memory: check them. Effects of the flasks and the healer's kit follow the PHB descriptions; how the game uses rope, torches, the crowbar and thieves' tools (story choices) is our own.

gear.name: Rope (50 feet)
gear.summary: Hempen rope. Opens climbing and roping choices in the story (Ashfall Pass).

gear.name: Torches
gear.summary: A bundle of torches. Light for dark places: opens choices like checking the cellar tunnel's timbers. Never runs out in this game.

gear.name: Hooded lantern
gear.summary: A steadier light than a torch. Works wherever torches do.

gear.name: Crowbar
gear.summary: For prying things open. Opens forcing choices in the story (the sealed dwarven arch).

gear.name: Thieves' tools
gear.summary: Picks and files for locks and traps. Opens lock-and-mechanism choices in the story (the King's Kiln door).

gear.name: Healer's kit
gear.summary: Bandages and salves. In a fight, use your action to stabilize a dying ally next to you, no Medicine check needed. Never runs out in this game.

gear.name: Alchemist's fire
gear.summary: A flask of sticky fire. Throw it (20 ft, a ranged attack): 1d4 fire on a hit, and it keeps burning for 1d4 each turn until the target shakes it off (DC 10 Dexterity).

gear.name: Holy water
gear.summary: A flask of blessed water. Throw it (20 ft, a ranged attack): 2d6 radiant to undead and fiends; harmless to anything else.

gear.name: Acid
gear.summary: A glass vial of acid. Throw it (20 ft, a ranged attack): 2d6 acid on a hit.
